This scene:
古代，孟子跟孟母住在墓地的旁边。可是孟母注意，住在墓地的旁边影响孟子。他常常跟朋友们祭拜玩，所以孟母决定他们会搬家。这次，他们住在城市里的商店的旁边，从早到晚很吵。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代，孟子跟孟母住在墓地的旁边：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 可是孟母注意：注意到，注意action vs.注意到result
- 他常常跟朋友们祭拜玩：祭拜着玩儿，V.着玩儿 do something just for fun
- 所以孟母决定他们会搬家：决定搬家
- 从早到晚很吵：都很吵

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 注意：注意到，The resultative complement 到 shows that Meng’s mother became aware of the following fact. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟朋友们祭拜玩：跟朋友们玩祭拜的游戏，玩 needs an object here; the revised phrase makes the activity a game. [rule: none]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 所以孟母决定他们会搬家：所以孟母决定搬家，决定 takes a verb phrase directly, so the repeated reference and future clause are unnecessary. [teacher rule: jueding_vp]

items.reason: 注意 needs the resultative complement 到 here to express that Meng's mother noticed the fact.
祭拜玩 does not use the required V着玩儿 pattern; 玩祭拜的游戏 is also a grammatical way to express playing a worship game.
决定 should directly take the verb phrase 搬家, without repeating 他们 or adding 会.
